risk_note: RV2 by path (admin module). Implements the four verify-phone operations of CT-24o ⑥ (the holder's own change under /admin/v1/me and the super admin's change for an ordinary account) and removes their planned marks; contract descriptions now point at BR-ID-45. Sending needs a TOTP-tier step-up and sends a code to the new number through the existing SMS port (fake adapter outside production); the pending change lives in Redis per account (new phone's blind index with the same context as the stored phone, code hash, wrong-code count; a new send replaces it), never in plain text (BR-ID-33). Submitting locks the account row, checks and consumes the code, then writes cipher, blind index, verify_phone_set_at, row_version + 1 and an audit row (masked numbers, changed_by self / super_admin, reason for the super path) in one transaction; until then the old number stays in force and SMS-tier step-up still goes to it; sessions are not revoked; wrong codes do not count toward failed_login_count, the fifth wrong code voids the pending code. No migration. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
